# AI Coding Consortium (AICC)

> The standards body for AI-readable specifications and the agent-native web. Standards:
> AICC Markdown (spec format), ADP (agents.txt + policy), AIX (content index), and the
> Agent Web Stack drafts (query, chunks, provenance, economics, identity, licensing).

## Docs

- [Agent view of this site](/index.md): full machine-readable overview
- [AICC Core 1.0](/spec/aicc-core-1.0.html): the normative spec format standard
- [ADP 1.0](/spec/adp-1.0.html): agents.txt and agent policy
- [AIX 1.0](/spec/aix-1.0.html): content index for differential crawling

## Note

This origin implements the standards it publishes: see /.well-known/agents.txt,
/.well-known/adp.json and /.well-known/aix.json. Content index beats crawling.
